slots.title: Profile: banner backdrop
where: /profile and /profile/[username] → components/profile/profile-view.tsx banner header, behind the avatar, name, meta, bio and actions
slots.css: page width (up to 1680) × 250–320 (grows with the bio); cover, centred; 55% opacity
slots.crop: The UI fades the image out top to bottom (solid to 25%, gone by 95%), so the readable part is the upper half: put the lights and the long ticker board there; the lower half can be near-black floor. The avatar and name sit bottom-left, the actions bottom-right. The right third is behind the player's oshi key art (faded at its sides), so keep that area simple. At 1680 wide only the middle ~80% of the height shows.
slots.lighting: neon, low-key: out-of-focus blue points of light on ink; follows UI state: the player's colour and the oshi's colour are washed over it
slots.fallback: The banner's own CSS background (player-colour wash, oshi-colour glow, faint grid) with a faint blue halftone over it.
slots.brief: A wide, low-contrast panorama of the trading floor at night from a balcony: a long curved ticker board glowing along the far wall in the upper half, rows of desks with small glowing monitors below it, soft volumetric light shafts. Mostly deep ink (#0a0c11) with hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) points of light; everything slightly out of focus so it reads as texture.
slots.notes: Sits on the theme's panel colour at 55% opacity, so in light mode it reads as a grey-blue haze: keep values dark and contrast low (no bright whites).

slots.title: Leaderboard: podium light
where: /leaderboard (page 1, 3+ players) → components/leaderboard/leaderboard.tsx podium, behind the three steps (2nd, 1st, 3rd left to right)
slots.css: page width (up to 1680) × ~170; phones: the steps stack (~360×400) and the image is cover-cropped to its centre; 70% opacity
slots.crop: Three soft vertical beams at 16%, 50% and 84% across (the step centres; the middle step is 15% wider), each running the full height so any horizontal band reads; the centre beam brightest and widest. Avatars sit at each step's left, rank numbers, names and equity to their right, all in the lower 70%: beams stay soft there. Phones show only the centre ~20% of the width, so the centre beam must carry it alone.
slots.lighting: neon: white and hololive-blue spotlight beams, no ambient fill
slots.fallback: Faint blue halftone over the podium's own step gradients (each step is tinted with the player's colour).
slots.brief: Stage light only, on a transparent background: three tall spotlight beams coming down from above (the centre one brightest), light haze inside the beams, a scatter of hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) and white confetti and a few falling order slips drifting through them, a faint glowing strip along the bottom edge like a stage lip. Flat shapes with halftone in the beams. No stage floor, wall or dark background.
slots.notes: Transparent on purpose: the podium sits on the theme background and its text uses the theme's text colour, so an opaque dark stage would bury the dark text in light mode. On dark ink the beams glow; on light paper the confetti and blue beams still show.
